home.title: Learn the combination, frame by frame.
home.subtitle: Premium dance teachers for dancers who want to own one combination deeply — mirrored, slowed down, and broken into counts.

tutorials.title: Tutorials & courses
tutorials.subtitle: Every tutorial includes a full count breakdown, mirrored and slowed practice modes, and a 30-day rental.
tutorials.empty: No tutorials to show right now.

teachers.title: Our teachers
teachers.subtitle: Every teacher at The Frame brings their own professional background — jazz funk, hip hop, and heels — and builds each combination so you can learn it deeply, frame by frame.

about.metaDescription: The Frame by Barzilay is a premium dance platform that teaches one combination deeply — frame by frame.
about.title: We learned to dance in the field. Now we teach you.
about.body: The Frame by Barzilay was born from one frustration: online dance teachers who skim the surface, move too fast, and never give dancers time to understand the movement. We built a platform that flips that — one combination, full depth.

values.title: Depth, not volume
values.description: Instead of dozens of shallow clips, we teach one combination at a time — until it lives in your body.

values.title: Real breakdowns
values.description: Every combination is broken into counts, with mirrored and slowed practice modes, so no move stays opaque.

values.title: Teachers from the field
values.description: Our teachers have danced in productions, music videos, and real competitions — and bring that experience straight into class.
